caption: Volunteer building a living willow dome in the sensory garden. Once these rods root and leaf out they'll create a brilliant natural play and shelter feature, and the early catkins are great for bees too (March 2026)

Work underway on the sensory garden timber gateway and entrance, weaving living willow rods into the boundary planting alongside natural stone and reclaimed timber. All sustainable materials creating a lovely outdoor classroom space right beside the school (March 2026)
